caption:
Refused? Do not reapply this week.

Your instinct is to submit again immediately. Don't. A refusal stays on your record and consulates can see it. The same weak file produces a second refusal — and now you are explaining two.

The letter identifies the category of the problem. Fix that first. Rebuild properly. Then apply.

slides.headline: DON'T REAPPLY THIS WEEK.
slides.sub: A second refusal is harder than the first.
slides.note: Refusals stay on your record. Resubmitting the same file just adds another one.

slides.headline: TO DO INSTEAD
items: Read the refusal letter and identify the category
Fix that specific weakness — not everything
Rebuild the file so it holds together
Then apply, with the gap closed

slides.headline: A STRONG APPLICATION NEXT MONTH BEATS A WEAK ONE TOMORROW.
slides.body: Nothing about resubmitting quickly improves your odds. Everything about rebuilding properly does.
